## What is Instagram Downloading?

Instagram doesn't provide an official way to download photos or videos. With InstaDown, you can save photos and reels from public posts in their original quality.

## How to Download

### Step 1: Copy the Link
On the Instagram app, tap the **share button (···)** on the post you want to save and select **'Copy Link'**.

### Step 2: Paste the URL
Paste the copied URL into the InstaDown input field and click **'Download'**.

### Step 3: Save
Click the download button on the extracted photo or video to save it. For carousel posts, use 'Download All' to save everything at once.

## Supported Content

- **Photo posts**: Download single photos in original quality
- **Reels**: Save videos in MP4 format
- **Carousels**: Download multiple photos/videos individually or in bulk

## Important Notes

- Only public posts can be downloaded.
- Downloaded content is copyrighted by the original creator.
- Unauthorized commercial use is prohibited.

lineBreak.title: How to Add Line Breaks on Instagram
lineBreak.metaTitle: Instagram Line Break Not Working? How to Fix Caption Enter Key | InstaDown
lineBreak.metaDescription: Why are Instagram line breaks disappearing? Learn why the enter key doesn't work in captions and how to fix it with invisible characters.
lineBreak.subtitle: Keep your line breaks in Instagram captions and bios
lineBreak.content:
## Why Do Line Breaks Disappear?

When typing text on Instagram, pressing Enter often results in line breaks disappearing. This happens because Instagram automatically removes consecutive blank lines.

## The Solution

### Method: Use InstaDown Line Break Tool
1. Enter your text in the **Line Break tool**.
2. Press Enter twice where you want line breaks.
3. Click the **'Copy'** button.
4. Paste into Instagram and your line breaks will be preserved.

### How It Works
This tool inserts an **invisible special character (U+200B, Zero-Width Space)** between blank lines. Instagram recognizes this character, so the blank lines are not removed.

## Tips

- **Organize captions**: Separate content into paragraphs for better readability.
- **Bio layout**: Arrange information neatly line by line.
- **Lists**: Format items in a list for a clean look.

Regular spacebar spaces are not recognized as blank lines on Instagram. Using a special Unicode character (U+3164, Hangul Filler) creates blank lines that Instagram preserves.

## How to Use

1. Select the number of blank spaces in the **Blank Space tool**.
2. Click the **'Copy'** button.
3. Paste into your Instagram bio or caption.

## Use Cases

- **Bio sections**: Separate name, job, contact info with blank lines
- **Caption spacing**: Add space between text and hashtags
- **Aesthetic layout**: Create a clean, organized profile look

items.question: How do I download Instagram photos?
items.answer: Simply paste the Instagram post URL into InstaDown and click the download button. You can save original high-quality photos for free without installing any app.

items.question: Can I download Instagram Reels?
items.answer: Yes, you can download Reels videos too. Paste the Reels URL and save the video in original quality.

items.question: Will the user be notified if I download their photo?
items.answer: No, downloading through InstaDown does not send any notification to the post owner. It only works with public posts.

items.question: Can I download from private accounts?
items.answer: No, InstaDown only supports public account posts. Private account content cannot be downloaded.

items.question: Do I need to sign up?
items.answer: No sign-up required. InstaDown is completely free to use with no download limits.

lineBreak.question: Why are my Instagram line breaks not working?
lineBreak.answer: Instagram automatically removes consecutive blank lines from captions. Regular enter keys create blank lines that disappear, so you need to use invisible special characters to keep your line breaks.

lineBreak.question: Can I add line breaks in my Instagram bio?
lineBreak.answer: Yes, our line break tool works for bios too. Enter your text, convert it, and copy the result to paste into your Instagram bio.

lineBreak.question: Does this work on mobile?
lineBreak.answer: Yes, it works on all mobile browsers. Copy the converted text and paste it directly into the Instagram app.

blankSpace.question: What is an Instagram blank space character?
blankSpace.answer: It's an invisible Unicode character that Instagram doesn't remove, unlike regular spaces. This lets you create empty gaps in your bio and captions.

blankSpace.question: How do I copy the blank space?
blankSpace.answer: Click the 'Copy' button in our tool and the blank character is automatically copied to your clipboard. Then paste it into Instagram using Ctrl+V or long-press on mobile.

blankSpace.question: Can I use multiple blank spaces?
blankSpace.answer: Yes, you can copy and paste as many blank characters as you need to create multiple empty lines.

fonts.question: How do Instagram font generators work?
fonts.answer: Unicode includes various styled characters beyond regular alphabets — bold, italic, cursive, etc. These are actual characters, not fonts, so they display correctly everywhere.

fonts.question: Do special fonts work with all languages?
fonts.answer: Unicode special fonts only apply to Latin alphabets and numbers. Other scripts like Korean, Japanese, or Chinese characters won't be converted, but you can mix them.

fonts.question: Why can't some people see my special fonts?
fonts.answer: Some older devices or browsers may not display certain Unicode characters properly. Most modern devices support them fully.

characterCounter.question: What is the Instagram caption character limit?
characterCounter.answer: Instagram captions can be up to 2,200 characters long. However, only the first 125 characters are shown in the feed preview, so put important content first.

characterCounter.question: How many characters can an Instagram bio have?
characterCounter.answer: Instagram bios have a 150 character limit. Emojis and special characters each count as one character.

characterCounter.question: How many hashtags can I use per post?
characterCounter.answer: You can use up to 30 hashtags per post. If you exceed 30, your caption won't be published.

imageResizer.question: What is the best Instagram feed photo size?
imageResizer.answer: The recommended sizes are: Square 1080×1080px, Portrait 1080×1350px, Landscape 1080×566px. Portrait photos take up the most feed space and get more engagement.

imageResizer.question: What size are Instagram Stories and Reels?
imageResizer.answer: Both Instagram Stories and Reels use 1080×1920px (9:16 aspect ratio).

imageResizer.question: Will resizing reduce image quality?
imageResizer.answer: Our resizer maintains maximum quality while adjusting dimensions. However, enlarging a small image may reduce quality, so start with a high-resolution original.

reelsThumbnail.question: How do I extract a Reels thumbnail?
reelsThumbnail.answer: Copy the Reels URL, paste it into InstaDown's Reels Thumbnail Extractor, and click the extract button. The cover image will be automatically extracted.

reelsThumbnail.question: What quality is the extracted thumbnail?
reelsThumbnail.answer: Thumbnails are extracted at the original resolution provided by Instagram, typically 1080×1920px high quality.

reelsThumbnail.question: Can I extract thumbnails from other people's Reels?
reelsThumbnail.answer: Yes, you can extract thumbnails from any public account's Reels. Private accounts are not supported.
